# Seeded behaviour
- [R-001] Exports keep original timestamps.
- [R-002] Sessions expire after 30 seconds.
- [R-003] Passwords shorter than 8 characters are rejected.
- [R-004] Clamp maximum is 100.
- [R-005] Names sort alphabetically.
- [R-006] Archives retain 7 entries.
- [R-007] CSV escapes quotes.
- [R-008] Pagination size is 20.
